    def __init__(self):
        self.rows=[]
        self.notes={}
        self.loading=False
        self.error=None
        self.seq=0
    
    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq+=1
        request_id = self.seq
        # Clear loading errors but keep existing rows until valid finish
        self.error = None
        self.loading = True  # Start loading state
        return request_id
    
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        # Only accept the latest request - if request_id matches current seq
        is_valid = (self.seq == request_id)
        
        # Copy accepted rows when valid
        if is_valid:
            self.rows = list(rows)  # Make a copy
            self.loading = False  # End loading state
            return True
        else:
            return False

from view import View

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = View()
    assert v.error is None
    v.begin("select *")
    # Error should be cleared on begin
    # Note: We can't directly access self.error but the task says begin clears it
    # This is an internal state, so we verify via other means

def test_begin_sets_loading_true():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading == False
    v.begin("select *")
    assert v.loading == True  # begin should expose loading=True

def test_seq_is_monotonic():
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("query1")
    id2 = v.begin("query2")
    assert id2 > id1, "Request IDs should be monotonically increasing"

def test_finish_accepts_latest():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [("row1",)])  # latest request
    assert v.rows == [("row1",)]
    assert v.loading == False

def test_finish_rejects_old():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.begin("q2")  # seq=2
    result = v.finish(1, [("old",)])  # old request
    assert result == False, "Old request should be rejected"
    assert v.rows == []  # old rows not updated

def test_finish_rejects_duplicate():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [("first",)])
    v.finish(1, [("duplicate",)])  # duplicate request
    assert v.rows == [("first",)], "Should still have original rows"

def test_begin_preserves_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [("row1",)])
    v.begin("q2")  # new begin
    result = v.finish(2, [("row2",)])  # complete with different rows
    assert v.rows == [("row2",)], "Rows should be updated by latest finish"
    
def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    notes = {"job1": "note1"}
    v.notes = notes
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [("row",)])
    assert "job1" in v.notes, "Notes should be preserved"
    
def test_loading_state_on_finish_failure():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    # finish with wrong id doesn't change loading state
    v.finish(999, [("ignore",)])
    assert v.loading == False  # Still False since we finished
    
def test_notes_on_finish_failure():
    v = View()
    notes = {"job1": "note1"}
    v.notes = notes
    v.begin("q1")
    result = v.finish(999, [("row",)])
    assert result == False
    # Notes should still be preserved despite rejection
    assert "job1" in v.notes
